patches.name: Disable AI motivational modal
patches.description: Prevents the AI-generated motivational modal from appearing after a blood pressure reading.

patches.name: Disable ad banner
patches.description: Prevents the rotating ad banner from appearing at the bottom of the Devices screen.

patches.name: Hide buy more devices link
patches.description: Hides the 'Buy more iHealth devices?' link at the bottom of the Devices screen.

patches.name: Rebrand app
patches.description: Changes the package name to allow installation alongside the original app and renames the app to 'iHealth Morphe'. Disables Firebase initialization, which would otherwise crash on startup when the new package name is not registered.

patches.name: Bypass DRM
patches.description: Prevents PairIP license check from running so the app does not redirect to the Play Store paywall on launch.

patches.name: Enable PRO
patches.description: Unlocks all PRO features by short-circuiting the purchase status check to always return true.
